component: Calder Find Your Fit / Fitment Finder
hero_competition_assessment: Does not compete with hero; desktop is materially under-scaled/compressed relative to baseline.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Desktop shell approximately 92–93% of 2048px reference / ~1904px, aligned to established Calder container.
corrections.discrepancy: Desktop component is ~450–470px too narrow, compressing all internal proportions.
corrections.recommended_correction: Restore established Calder container relationship; at 2048px QA width target ~1900px shell / ~74px gutters unless verified accepted container token differs. Do not create a new global container.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Tabs approximately 90–94px high with substantial attached premium cap geometry.
corrections.observed_implementation: Tabs are approximately 43–45px high and compact.
corrections.recommended_correction: Increase desktop tabs toward 88–94px height and restore proportional horizontal padding/width; preserve active bronze indicator and inactive cool-gray state.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Main shell approximately 370–372px excluding tabs; ~462px including tabs.
corrections.discrepancy: Vertical composition is compressed and loses intentional negative space.
corrections.recommended_correction: Increase shell toward ~370px excluding tabs; restore top/bottom padding and header-to-control breathing room rather than merely stretching controls.

corrections.baseline_requirement: FIND YOUR FIT uses approved Calder typography, ~52–58px desktop, 700–800 visual weight; supporting UI uses approved supporting typography.
corrections.observed_implementation: Heading and much UI appear in a different high-contrast serif/display treatment; desktop heading ~47–50px.
corrections.discrepancy: Typography materially changes the approved premium technical character.
corrections.recommended_correction: Use approved Calder/theme font tokens; target ~52–58px desktop heading with tight ~1.0 line height, white FIND YOUR and bronze FIT; correct labels/selects/status/actions to approved supporting typography.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Shared low-contrast wheel technical drawing plus contour/flow detail at ~8–22% effective opacity.
corrections.observed_implementation: By Vehicle artwork is barely visible; By Wheel Style shows a large empty/broken-looking rectangular image region.
corrections.discrepancy: Approved technical artwork is not reproduced consistently and Wheel Style exposes an apparent asset/container failure.
corrections.recommended_correction: Restore one shared decorative technical-art layer in both modes; remove visible empty/broken image box; position wheel upper-middle/right with subdued contour detail and navy fade.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Desktop selects approximately 70–72px high with consistent labels, values, borders and alignment.
corrections.discrepancy: Selectors are materially smaller/denser than baseline.
corrections.recommended_correction: Increase desktop selects to ~70–72px and scale padding/value typography accordingly; use same dimensions for Wheel Type/Diameter/Finish/Style.

corrections.baseline_requirement: FIND WHEELS approximately 360–370px × 78–82px at reference desktop scale.
corrections.recommended_correction: Increase CTA toward 360–370px × 78–82px at reference scale, preserving near-black fill, restrained ~2px bronze border, 8–10px radius and arrow.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Selected-vehicle region roughly rightmost 23–24%, ~400–420px at reference scale, with generous padding, strong vehicle typography, status and separated lower actions.
corrections.observed_implementation: Region is ~230px wide and compressed; Wheel Style visibly duplicates/concatenates the vehicle name.
corrections.discrepancy: Status panel proportions diverge and Wheel Style has a content-rendering defect.
corrections.recommended_correction: Restore ~76/24 finder/status relationship as shell expands, targeting ~400–420px status width at 2048px reference scale; restore padding/typography and fix duplicate vehicle name so it appears once.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Thin outline, ~16–18px radius and broad soft shadow into light content.
corrections.observed_implementation: Radius/outline present but elevation is weak.
corrections.discrepancy: Bottom transition reads flatter than approved.
corrections.recommended_correction: Preserve border/radius and strengthen only broad soft bottom elevation toward ~18–32px offset / 35–55px blur / low-opacity black; no hard/glowing shadow.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Approved composition contains intentional negative space and no Popular Searches row.
corrections.observed_implementation: Popular Searches links appear beneath controls.
corrections.discrepancy: Unapproved visual element consumes approved spacing.
corrections.recommended_correction: Remove Popular Searches from this component for visual conformance unless independently approved as a required feature.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Mobile priority: tabs → heading/copy → inputs → CTA → selected vehicle; near/full-width practical controls, no overflow, ~44px+ touch targets; artwork may be hidden.
corrections.observed_implementation: Ordering, 2×2 controls, CTA and no-overflow behavior are broadly sound; artwork is suppressed. Typography remains mismatched and selected-vehicle area is dense.
corrections.discrepancy: Core mobile structure conforms to assumptions; shared typography/status spacing still diverge.
corrections.recommended_correction: Retain mobile structural approach and 2×2 grid. Correct typography, preserve ~44px+ targets, and add sufficient selected-vehicle padding/readability. Do not restore art if it harms readability.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Bronze restrained, green confirmation-only, fitment visually subordinate to hero.
corrections.observed_implementation: Color hierarchy is broadly compliant and fitment does not overpower hero.
corrections.discrepancy: No major hierarchy failure; desktop is under-scaled rather than over-dominant.
corrections.recommended_correction: Preserve restrained colors while correcting dimensions; do not add brightness, glow or decorative dominance.

implementation_boundary: Visual corrections only. Preserve working functionality and use REUSE → RESTYLE → EXTEND → CREATE.
